thresholds.move_note: Howell: normal MOVE ~50–90 centered near 70; thesis watch band 70–80; sustained ≥80 = collateral-multiplier / accident residual. Buybacks respond to vol/liquidity (≈$30B per +10 MOVE), not YCC. Each ~10pt MOVE fall ≈ +$3tn GLI.
thresholds.sofr_minus_2y_note: Howell: primary warning = sharp downward lurch in SOFR−2y (no absolute cutoff in corpus). Secondary: SOFR/repo vs Fed funds — normally ≲~2bp gap; cited stress example ~9bp above FF target. Chip flags narrowing toward 0 / positive as pressure; do not invent a hard SOFR−2y cut.
thresholds.bills_note: 3-3-3-30: bills → ~30% of outstanding debt. Corpus: 22.2% (Apr) / ~23% (11 Sep); 25% was end-2027 projection, not the target. Rising share = Treasury QE channel; stress = front-end indigestion (repo/SOFR), not the share alone.
thresholds.reserves_note: Ample reserves ≠ easy funding (dealer BS scarce). Operate at/above 'adequate' (corpus markers historically ~$3.35T then revised ~$2.5T; actuals cited ~$3.1T). RMP was plumbing backstop after late-2025 QT/repo stress; Aug–Sep pause was seasonal in Howell reading. Live series not wired in v1.
